acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Lessons, practice questions, study materials and textbook links are free to use.
Lessons and saved materials can be read offline after they have been opened or saved. Progress made offline syncs when the connection returns.

mainEntity.name: Which boards and classes are supported?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maharashtra SSC and HSC, plus CBSE, for Class 1–12. Streams are available for Class 11–12.
